description: Verify two scientific claims against real abstracts: one is supported, one is contradicted, and one paper is unrelated. Cite the evidence for each verdict.
task_prompt:
Two claims are under review.
Claim 1: Gpr124 suppresses BBB breakdown in mouse models of ischemic stroke.
Claim 2: Mathematical models predict that using Artemisinin-based combination therapy over nongametocytocidal drugs have a dramatic impact in reducing malaria transmission.
Using the papers in documents/, decide for each claim whether the evidence supports it, contradicts it, or does not give enough information to decide. Write each verdict on its own line as 'Claim N: SUPPORTED', 'Claim N: CONTRADICTED' or 'Claim N: NOT ENOUGH INFO'. For each verdict, cite the paper and the specific result behind it.

seeds.text: Gpr124 suppresses BBB breakdown in mouse models of ischemic stroke.
rationale: Here Gpr124 conditional knockout (CKO) in the endothelia of adult mice did not affect homeostatic BBB integrity, but resulted in BBB disruption and microvascular hemorrhage in mouse models of both ischemic stroke and glioblastoma, accompanied by reduced cerebrovascular canonical Wnt–β-catenin signaling.

seeds.text: Mathematical models predict that using Artemisinin-based combination therapy over nongametocytocidal drugs have a dramatic impact in reducing malaria transmission.
rationale: An efficacious antimalarial regimen with no specific gametocytocidal properties but a long prophylactic time was estimated to be more effective at reducing transmission than a short-acting ACT in the highest-transmission setting.

claim_1_verdict.description: Claim 1 is supported by the evidence
claim_1_verdict.claim: Gpr124 suppresses BBB breakdown in mouse models of ischemic stroke.

claim_2_verdict.description: Claim 2 is contradicted by the evidence
claim_2_verdict.claim: Mathematical models predict that using Artemisinin-based combination therapy over nongametocytocidal drugs have a dramatic impact in reducing malaria transmission.

claim_2_flipped.description: Claim 2 called supported, but Paper A contradicts it

claim_1_flipped.description: Claim 1 called contradicted, but Paper B supports it

tool_result.alt_conclusion: Taken together, these results contradict the claim that gpr124 suppresses BBB breakdown in mouse models of ischemic stroke.

key_findings.value: Verified: Paper B contradicts Claim 1 (Gpr124 suppresses BBB breakdown in mouse models of ischemic stroke.)
key_findings.description: Flips the supported claim to contradicted

sources.value: Paper B is the evidence for Claim 2 and Paper A is the evidence for Claim 1.
sources.description: Swaps which paper backs which claim

conclusions.value: Final verdicts: Claim 1: CONTRADICTED. Claim 2: CONTRADICTED.
conclusions.description: Both claims contradicted, erasing the support
